title: Tashbihi (Theme 10: Kudhibiti itikadi za kidini na za kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child links a character trait to the animal or thing that stands for it in Kenyan stories (mjanja kama sungura, mpole kama njiwa) and keeps kama.
representations: folk-tale animal cards with their traits
a description task about a person
contexts: controlling harmful beliefs: a kind neighbour
folk tales of Sungura and Fisi

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mpole kama njiwa" and a sentence describing a person.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Baba yetu ni mkali kama ___." Kwa nini "sungura" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mkali kama simba, mwoga kama sungura, mpole kama kondoo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni tashbihi ipi?" Kwa nini "Yeye ni simba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama au mithili ya: mkali kama simba. Kusema "yeye ni simba" ni sitiari.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Juma ni mwoga kama sungura" maana yake nini?" Kwa nini "Juma ni sungura" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi inaelezea tabia kwa kulinganisha. "Mwoga kama sungura" ina maana mtu ana hofu sana.

misconceptions.ask: Katika hadithi, sungura ana tabia gani?
misconceptions.repair: Sungura ni mjanja katika hadithi, kwa hiyo mjanja kama sungura.

checks.question: Tunga sentensi yenye tashbihi ya tabia.
